title: LLM-Mini-CEX: Automatic Evaluation of Large Language Model for Diagnostic Conversation
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. The key findings relate to the creation of a new evaluation criterion (LLM-specific Mini-CEX) for medical LLMs and the performance of different models on it. For instance, it found that automatic evaluation can replace manual evaluation for humanistic care qualities and that GPT-4 performed best on humanistic care, while all tested LLMs achieved low results on comprehensive diagnosis and treatment abilities.
